mcp.endpoint_or_package: Hosted by ATTOM; endpoint URL not published. MCP V2 is current and requires provisioning through the ATTOM Intelligence Platform via a sales rep (not self-service).
tools: Tool names not published. FAQ lists data mapped to tools: property details, ownership information, AVMs, comparable sales, sales history, tax history, permit data, community characteristics, schools, points of interest, market context, risk-related data.
mcp.read_write: read (FAQ describes it as an access layer that does not modify data)
mcp.auth: key-based authentication aligned with ATTOM's existing systems

endpoints_relevant: Sales Comparables endpoint (added in ATTOM API v2.0.0; path not on fetched pages)
Current API version is V4 (component APIs dropped from URI)
api.auth: apikey request header; ATTOM Cloud account gives a 30-day evaluation key
api.rate_limits: not established (developer portal returned 403 to this fetch)

recent_changes.date: on or about 2026-10-05 (support page said 'Last updated 1 day ago' on 2026-10-06; exact launch date not established)
recent_changes.change: ATTOM launched MCP V2 as part of the ATTOM Intelligence Platform; access requires provisioning through a sales rep, no self-service activation.

deprecations.item: Older endpoints on the OBI database deprecated June 30, 2023 (moved to V4)
DLP v1/v2/v3 no longer sold; Neighborhood API deprecated; DLP v1 kept only for PlatMaps
Estated API still supported but not marketed to new customers; migration into ATTOM API underway
